name: DominoStock – Multi-Store Inventory Sync & Stock Manager for WooCommerce
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoStock is an advanced, high-performance WooCommerce inventory management and multi-store stock synchronization plugin built with a modern React single-page interface.

Effortlessly manage stock levels, connect multiple WooCommerce stores via secure REST API & real-time webhooks, track total asset inventory valuations, and automatically synchronize catalog stock statuses (instock, outofstock, onbackorder) across all your connected stores without page refreshes.

Whether you run a single WooCommerce store needing instant stock updates and low-stock alerts, or a growing multi-store retail network needing centralized stock management, DominoStock delivers seamless real-time stock synchronization with enterprise-grade loop safety and zero race conditions.

🌟 Key Feature Highlights

1. Real-Time Inventory Analytics Dashboard

Get a high-level command center of your entire inventory health across your primary hub and all connected child stores:
* Real-Time Key Metrics: Track total products, stock on hand, catalog health score percentage, low stock alerts, out-of-stock risk counters, and total asset inventory valuation in your active currency.
* Interactive ApexCharts Visualizations:
* Stock Health Status: Donut chart analyzing in-stock vs at-risk items.
* Stock Depth Tiers: Bar chart categorizing product stock depth across critical (1-5), low (6-20), moderate (21-50), and high (50+) ranges.
* Multi-Store Share: Distribution chart breaking down physical units on hand across every store.
* Store-by-Store Inventory Breakdown: Comprehensive comparison table displaying product counts, units on hand, health scores, and localized asset values for every connected location.
* Smart Filter & Watchlist: Instantly filter analytics by individual child store or view your global store network simultaneously.

2. High-Speed Inventory Tracker & Stock Manager

Replace clunky WooCommerce backend pages with a lightning-fast React inventory table:
* Fast Search & Filtering: Search by product title or SKU, filter by store, product category or stock status (In Stock, Low Stock, Out of Stock), and sort by stock quantity, product name or price. Categories are grouped by store, keeping identical category IDs in different stores separate.
* Edit Stock Modal: Use the compact Edit Stock action to update parent stock, individual variation quantities, manage stock flags, and stock statuses without leaving the page.
* Compact, Responsive Controls: Consistent small filter and action controls, plus a category menu with a bounded, scrollable list.
* Bulk Stock Spreadsheet Editor:
* Multi-select products with one click—child variations are automatically loaded and displayed in an intuitive spreadsheet view.
* Quick Batch Actions: Set exact quantities, increase stock (+N), decrease stock (-N), update catalog status, or toggle stock management across dozens of products and variations at once.
* Expand/collapse variation hierarchies and reset changes before saving via batch REST API.
* Free / Pro Variation Limits: The free bulk spreadsheet includes the first 10 variations per product. Batch actions and saving apply only to those included rows. DominoStock Pro removes this per-product variation limit.

3. Import Inventory from CSV / Excel

Update existing product and variation stock using a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) inventory file:
* Stock Field Updates: Edit stock quantities, stock statuses, and stock management settings in an exported file, then import it from the Inventory Tracker.
* Multi-Store Product Identity: Store, product, and parent IDs identify the correct products and variations across connected stores.
* Validation & Progress: File validation runs before processing, followed by batch updates with progress indicators and updated/failed row counts.
* Downloadable Error Reports: Review individual row failures and download a report for correction. Successful updates remain applied.
* File Limits: Supports up to 20,000 rows, including variations, and import files up to 5 MB within the server upload limit.

4. Export Inventory to CSV / Excel

Download inventory as CSV or Excel (.xlsx) directly from the Export menu:
* All Data (Pro): Export published products from the primary store and every active child store, independently of table filters. Requires DominoStock Pro.
* Visible Data: Export products on the current inventory table page.
* Selected Data: Export products selected across pages. This option becomes available when products are selected.
* Variation Support: Each export includes the exported products’ variations and store/product/parent identity columns for re-importing stock updates.

5. Product-Level Stock History / Timeline

Open Stock History beside Edit Stock to inspect a product’s recorded stock changes:
* Before & After Values: View quantity transitions, stock status changes, and stock tracking changes in a paginated timeline.
* Change Context: See timestamps, change sources, and editor information when available.
* Store-Specific History: Keep each store’s product history separate, with variation changes included in the parent product timeline.
* Tracking Baseline: History starts with the first recorded observation or stock save. Remote observations show when a change was detected; earlier changes and unknown remote editors are not reconstructed.

6. Multi-Store Manager (Hub & Child Architecture)

Connect and coordinate multiple WooCommerce stores with zero technical friction:
* Connect Unlimited Child Stores: Link external WooCommerce shops via standard WooCommerce REST API Consumer Keys and Secrets.
* Built-in Setup Guide: Interactive step-by-step key generation instructions right inside the connection modal.
* 1-Click API Connection Test: Verify live REST API connectivity and credentials before saving.
* Flexible Synchronization Directions:
* Child to Hub (pull_from_child): Deducts hub stock when orders occur on child stores, and updates hub stock upon child manual edits.
* Bidirectional (bidirectional): Fully synchronizes stock bi-directionally—orders on any store update the Hub and all other child stores, and manual edits on the Hub propagate to the entire network.
* Independent Controls: Enable or pause auto-sync per individual child store at any time.

7. Automated Inventory Sync & Connection Pre-Flight Checklist

Ensure robust, error-free synchronization across your store network:
* Global Master Switch: Enable or disable automatic real-time stock synchronization network-wide.
* Automated Event Triggers: Auto-sync inventory on order placement, order cancellations/refunds, and product updates.
* Sync All Stores Now: 1-click manual reconciliation that pushes or syncs stock levels across all eligible stores with immediate execution feedback.
* Pre-Flight Connection & Setup Checklist:
1. WooCommerce Active: Confirms WooCommerce is running on Hub and Child stores.
2. REST API Keys Active: Verifies Read/Write permissions for uninterrupted communication.
3. Permalink Format: Checks that WordPress permalinks are set to “Post name” for REST endpoints and webhooks.
4. Security Whitelist: Guidance for whitelisting REST API endpoints in Cloudflare, Wordfence, or security plugins.
5. URL Format Verification: Ensures clean store URLs without trailing slashes or subfolder routing issues.
* Product Sync Requirements Guide: Clear guidelines for SKU matching across simple products and complex variations.

8. Live Sync Activity Monitor

Gain complete transparency over every background stock synchronization event:
* Live 5-Second Polling: Real-time event stream that updates continuously without requiring page reloads.
* Visual Stock Transitions: Instant visibility into stock quantity changes (e.g., Old: 66 → New: 62 (-4)).
* Direction Badges: Clear visual indicators for flow directions (Child Order → Hub, Hub → Child Broadcast, etc.).
* Diagnostic Audit Logs: Inspect payload data, order IDs, timestamps, and retry failed operations with 1-click.

9. Enterprise-Grade Reliability & Performance

  • Loop-Safe Architecture: Intelligent originating store tracking prevents infinite circular webhook loops between connected stores.
  • 100% HPOS Compatible: Built from the ground up for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (Custom Order Tables).
  • Modern React & Chakra UI Admin: Ultra-responsive SPA interface built for speed, clean UX, and zero reload latency.

🚀 Upgrade to DominoStock Pro

Unlock automated real-time multi-store inventory synchronization via webhooks, unlimited connected stores, bidirectional multi-store syncing, and dedicated priority support.

👉 Upgrade to DominoStock Pro
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/dominostock-inventory-sync/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins dashboard (Plugins > Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to DominoStock in your WordPress admin menu to configure your stores, view inventory analytics, or manage stock.
sections.faq:
Does DominoStock support multi-store inventory sync?

Yes! DominoStock allows you to connect multiple WooCommerce child stores to your primary hub site using standard WooCommerce REST API credentials and real-time webhooks.

How do I connect a remote child store?

Go to DominoStock > Stores, click Connect Child Store, enter your child store URL, and paste the WooCommerce REST API Consumer Key and Consumer Secret with Read/Write permissions. You can test the connection with 1 click before saving.

Can I sync stock for variable products and product variations?

Yes. DominoStock intelligently matches product variations by SKU or variation attributes, ensuring that only the exact purchased variation’s stock is updated across your store network.

How does real-time stock synchronization work?

When an order is created, edited, or cancelled on any connected store, a secure webhook payload is dispatched to update inventory quantities across all stores instantly without overselling.

How does DominoStock prevent circular webhook loops?

DominoStock features a built-in loop-safe architecture. Every webhook payload contains originating store metadata; connected stores recognize the original sender and will never re-broadcast the same stock event back into the network.

Can I bulk edit stock across multiple products at once?

Yes. The built-in Bulk Stock Spreadsheet Editor allows you to select multiple products, automatically loads all their variations, and lets you apply batch rules (set exact quantity, add +N, subtract -N, change stock status, or toggle stock management) with a single click.

Is DominoStock compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, DominoStock is 100% compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS / Custom Order Tables).

Does DominoStock work with bulk imports or manual stock updates?

Yes. Use Import in the Inventory Tracker to select a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) inventory file. Start with a DominoStock export, edit manage_stock, stock_quantity, and stock_status, and keep store_id, product_id, and parent_id unchanged. Import updates existing products and variations; it does not create products. The file is validated before processing, and individual update failures are reported without rolling back successful rows.

What do the inventory export options include?

All Data (Pro) exports published products from the primary store and every active child store, independently of the table filters, and requires DominoStock Pro. Visible Data exports the current table page. Selected Data exports products selected across pages and is disabled until a product is selected. Visible and Selected exports remain available in the free version. Each option also includes the exported products’ variations. Choose CSV or Excel (.xlsx) from the Export menu.

Are there inventory transfer limits or server requirements?

Transfers support up to 20,000 rows, including variations. Import files must be no larger than 5 MB and must also fit the server upload limit. Excel import reads the first worksheet and requires the PHP ZIP extension. Excel support also requires mbstring, zlib, SimpleXML, and libxml. Keep the transfer window open until processing finishes. Store IDs refer to this installation’s connections, so keep identity columns unchanged when re-importing an export.

Does Stock History show changes made before this version was installed?

No. History begins with the first recorded observation or stock save after tracking is enabled. The first entry is a baseline, not a reconstructed stock change. Standard WooCommerce stock hooks record local changes. Child-store changes are recorded from plugin API updates, subsequent reads, or enabled authenticated product webhooks. For observed changes, the timestamp is when the change was detected; the original remote edit time and editor may be unknown. Previously recorded history remains available if the remote store cannot be refreshed.

What extra features are included in DominoStock Pro?

DominoStock Pro unlocks automated real-time multi-store inventory synchronization via webhooks on child store orders, bidirectional multi-store syncing, and dedicated priority support. Upgrade to DominoStock Pro.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Limited the free bulk spreadsheet to 10 variations per product, with a Pro upgrade prompt and backend enforcement before stock writes. Pro supports unlimited variations per product.
  • Added store-aware category filtering with categories from the primary store and all active child stores, grouped by store to prevent category ID collisions.
  • Made Export All Data a Pro feature with the existing upgrade modal and server-side license checks at export start and each batch. Visible and Selected exports remain available in the free version.
  • Added CSV and Excel (.xlsx) inventory exports for all stores, the visible table page, or products selected across pages. Selected export is disabled until products are selected.
  • Added CSV/Excel stock import for existing products and variations, with full file validation before processing, batch progress, per-row failure reporting, and downloadable error reports.
  • Added variation rows and store/product/parent identity columns to inventory exports for multi-store stock round trips.
  • Added product-level Stock History beside Edit Stock, showing quantity, stock status, tracking changes, timestamps, sources, and available editor information in a paginated timeline.
  • Added separate history baselines for each store/product, duplicate observation suppression, and variation events in parent product timelines.
  • Added stock history observation for WooCommerce stock/save hooks, child-store API reads and confirmed updates, and authenticated product webhooks. Remote observations do not claim an unknown original editor or edit time.
  • Added the stock history table to the central database schema manager with automatic schema version migration to 1.5.0.
  • Improved child-store variation fetching to include all pages rather than stopping at the first 100 variations.
  • Improved inventory transfer dialogs with status cards, progress indicators, row summaries, file-limit badges, and a collapsible import editing guide.
  • Improved filter bar responsiveness and made filter, search, import/export, bulk update, and refresh controls consistently small.
  • Improved the category dropdown with compact width, viewport-aware maximum height, and a scrollable list.
  • Replaced the quick stock adjustment icon with a small Edit Stock button and removed the external WooCommerce edit icon from table actions.
  • Fixed the Reset Original notification crash caused by an unsupported toast status.
  • Added Excel reader/writer dependencies for CSV and native .xlsx inventory transfers.

1.2.0

  • Added Multi-Store Inventory Synchronization (Hub-to-Child & Bidirectional).
  • Added Real-time order stock deductions and webhook sync dispatcher.
  • Added Live Sync Activity Monitor audit log with 5s polling and visual stock change indicators.
  • Added Multi-Store Manager with REST API credentials and connection testing.
  • Added Advanced Inventory Analytics with ApexCharts, stock depth tiers, and valuation metrics.
  • Added Bulk Stock Spreadsheet Editor with batch quantity adjustments (+N, -N, set exact, status).
  • Added Quick Adjust Stock modal for instant product and variation edits.
  • Added Pre-Flight Connection & Setup Checklist for seamless child store linking.
  • Fixed circular sync loop prevention with originating store tracking.
  • Fixed variable product SKU handling to ensure only modified variations update across stores.
  • Verified 100% compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).

1.1.0

  • Upgraded to modern React and Webpack architecture matching BundlePress.
  • Added Stock Analytics with ApexCharts and inventory valuation.
  • Added Dry-run simulation and batch sync controls.
  • Added quick stock adjustment modal and automated sync triggers.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
